description: This file defines the 'Waiter' class within the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for polling AWS resources until a specified state is reached. It manages asynchronous operations, handles retries, and incorporates configuration for customizing wait behavior.

classes.name: Waiter
classes.description: Represents an AWS resource waiter that polls resource status until a specific condition is met or times out. Supports asynchronous waiting using promises and includes configuration for delay, retries, and success/failure criteria.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Waiter object with an AWS client, waiter name, command arguments, and configuration options, validating required parameters.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when the waiter reaches success or rejects on failure or exceeding maximum attempts.

methods.name: getArgsForAttempt
methods.description: Constructs and returns the arguments for a specific polling attempt, including managing delay timings.

methods.name: determineState
methods.description: Evaluates the result of a polling attempt to determine whether the waiter has succeeded, failed, or should retry.

methods.name: matchesPath
methods.description: Checks if the result matches a specific path and expected value based on acceptor configuration.

methods.name: matchesPathAll
methods.description: Checks if all actual values at a path match the expected value, based on acceptor configuration.

methods.name: matchesPathAny
methods.description: Checks if any actual value at a path matches the expected value, based on acceptor configuration.

methods.name: matchesStatus
methods.description: Checks if the response status code matches the expected status.

methods.name: matchesError
methods.description: Determines if the encountered error matches the expected error conditions.
